Native MeTTa accepted only one named project-kind relation plus recognized continuity facets and selected only an exactly unique in-scope registry match. This is a bounded kind/facet ontology, not general entity resolution.

The historical exact sentence and the already inspected R1 paraphrase passed without any sentence entry in runtime source. Both are disclosed regressions; neither is a genuine post-freeze held-out evaluation.
